sources.authors: Michael L. Parks; Eric de Sturler; Greg Mackey; Duane D. Johnson; Spandan Maiti
sources.retrieval: Exa search plus author-hosted PDF fetch, first 10000 characters
sources.use: Recycling changes the retained subspace and its current operator images; source-specific shifted-image defect identity is derived in K4, not attributed as a new general recycling method.

sources.title: Why logarithmic norms?
sources.use: Signed stability bounds motivate the weighted numerical-abscissa assumption. K3.3 is proved directly by the weighted inner-product coercivity argument.
